name: io.github.flumpiey/linkwarden-mcp
title: Linkwarden MCP
description: MCP server for Linkwarden bookmarks: read-first search and preserved content, with opt-in scoped write and delete tools.

environmentVariables.name: LINKWARDEN_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer API token from Linkwarden settings

environmentVariables.name: LINKWARDEN_MCP_WRITE_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated write scopes: links,collections,tags,raw. Empty = read-only.

environmentVariables.name: LINKWARDEN_MCP_DELETE_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated delete scopes (never implied by write). Empty = no deletes.
